gaps.answer: invited him to join them for
gaps.lead: 'Would you like to join us for dinner?' they asked him.
gaps.explanation: invite somebody TO do something; pronouns shift in reporting.

gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
gaps.sentence: I think it's only ___ Jemma becomes a famous model.
gaps.explanation: 'It's only a matter of time before' means it will definitely happen eventually.

gaps.lead: A long, dry summer caused the famine.
gaps.sentence: The famine ___ a long, dry summer.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = B results from A (note the direction).

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was so rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ so rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing: apologised for being so rude.

gaps.lead: Given that he has no experience, will Glyn be able to do this job?
gaps.sentence: Will Glyn's ___ his ability to do this job?
gaps.hint: no experience = lack of experience (noun subject)
gaps.explanation: The noun subject 'lack of experience' takes the verb 'affect'.

gaps.lead: As well as speaking fluent French, she also speaks Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition to = as well as.
